definition.supported_domain: Canonical peptide backbone in validated connectivity; separate general/Gly/cisPro/transPro/prePro/IleVal classes.
definition.perception_requirements: Peptide linkage, identity, prior omega and next-Pro context; altloc/occupancy and missing atoms explicit.
definition.raw_measurements: Phi/psi/omega with atom IDs; class assignment; interpolated distribution value and grid/method pin.
definition.classification_semantics: Favored/allowed/outlier only under reviewed empirical model. Current cctbx cutoffs are reference-specific contour probabilities, not angle boxes.
definition.sufficient_negative_coverage: All evaluable backbone residues assigned correct class; chain ends/missing atoms separately not evaluated; population denominators explicit.
definition.coordinate_state_requirements: One explicitly selected immutable structural/chemical state; source IDs, bonds, charge/H/stereo, coordinate units, component roles, complete system scope and alternate/model identity. Pocket is a view only.
